bull.b: ARR growth and 126% NRR show customers are expanding usage, while bundled devices and cloud workflows can raise switching costs. This recurring model improves revenue visibility and supports durable lifetime value as agencies digitize evidence and operations.

Revenue growth across software, devices and platform solutions, alongside raised guidance, indicates broad demand rather than reliance on one product. Continued bookings and contracted backlog provide visibility into execution over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Strong software economics and gross margins
bull.b: High gross margins and fast software expansion support a scalable business model as cloud, AI and digital evidence products grow. Greater software mix can improve recurring economics and provide resources for continued product development and market expansion.

bear.b: Operating profitability remains uneven: TTM net margin is about 6.2%, ROE about 5.9%, and the company recorded an operating loss in 2025. This limits evidence that strong gross margins will consistently translate into durable bottom-line returns.

bear.t: Weak cash conversion and working-capital needs
bear.b: TTM free cash flow of about $133M is only 50% of net income, while coverage is about 0.19. Inventory investment also produced a quarterly FCF outflow, so growth may continue to require working capital and constrain cash flexibility.

Axon’s cloud, cameras and AI tools handle sensitive public-safety data, making privacy and security governance central to adoption. Misuse concerns or inadequate controls could damage trust, slow procurement and increase compliance costs across the platform.
